must_find.description: After legitimate operations connection.rotate changes provider generation, desk-view mail.list on that existing registry first fails generation check. Retry reconnects and copies the envelope without account context. Transport substitutes its north maintenance identity, whose provider credential legitimately reads operations-inbox. Caller receives Operations private release rather than Mira inbox. Requires own north read token plus an ordinary connection replacement; attacker need not possess admin/maintenance credentials or directly select context/account. Healthy first-attempt reads stay caller-bound. Entire failure/retry/provider path is supplied and deterministic. The attacker mail call must occur before any other mail call reconnects that shared transport.
